note.body:
Hi Alex,

I'm pleased to share the onboarding package for Diana Okafor, who will join us as a Senior Data Scientist on the ml_platform team. Diana starts in 21 days on 2026-07-05.

We've scheduled the intro meeting for 2026-07-06 at 10:00 AM for 30 minutes.

I'd suggest Ben Silva as Diana’s onboarding buddy. Ben has expertise in model serving and feature stores, closely aligning with Diana’s role, and his experience and availability make him a strong fit for providing support.

Attached is a draft of the 30-60-90 day plan. It's a starting point for you to review and personalize to fit how you’d like to approach Diana’s onboarding.

Finally, please review the manager prep checklist below for comprehensive guidance.

Best,  
The Onboarding Team

thirty_days: Learn the architecture of the ML platform by reviewing documentation and shadowing team members.
Integrate into engineering workflows by completing a GitHub pull request on a minor bug fix or documentation update.
Meet with key team members and related teams to understand their data needs and current projects (5 meetings).
sixty_days: Build a machine learning model for a small feature by collaborating with engineering using Datadog for monitoring and feedback loops.
Lead a retrospective session about an ongoing project to gain insights into team processes.
Solidify relationships with cross-functional teams by participating in at least 3 interdisciplinary meetings.
ninety_days:
Deliver a comprehensive analysis report on the feature performance of a newly shipped model.
Present findings to the team and stakeholders.
Propose a project to improve the efficiency of data pipelines leveraging AWS and orchestrating work across data and engineering teams.
Establish a thought-leadership role within the team by authoring a blog post on a technical topic of interest.

manager_checklist: Review Diana Okafor’s resume and skills profile.
Ensure all systems access, including AWS, will be ready for July 5.
Plan first 1:1 to discuss initial projects and expectations.
Review current data science projects for potential involvement.

details.subject_line: Welcome to the ML Platform Team, Diana!
details.body:
Hi Diana,

Welcome to the ML Platform team! We're thrilled to have you join us as a Senior Data Scientist. On your first day, you'll find your MacBook Pro all set up and ready for you, and you'll have access to all the essential tools like GitHub Enterprise, Slack (especially our engineering channels), and Datadog.

You're in great hands with your onboarding buddy, Ben Silva, who will be reaching out to help you settle in. Plus, you'll have an introductory meeting with your manager on July 6th at 10:00 AM.

We're really looking forward to seeing you shine in your role here. If you have any questions or need anything before you start, feel free to reach out!

Warm regards,
The ML Platform Team

note.body:
Hi Alex,

I'm pleased to share the onboarding package for Diana Okafor, who will join us as a Senior Data Scientist on the ml_platform team. Diana starts in 21 days on 2026-07-05.

We've scheduled the intro meeting for 2026-07-06 at 10:00 AM for 30 minutes.

I'd suggest Ben Silva as Diana’s onboarding buddy. Ben has expertise in model serving and feature stores, closely aligning with Diana’s role, and his experience and availability make him a strong fit for providing support.

Attached is a draft of the 30-60-90 day plan. It's a starting point for you to review and personalize to fit how you’d like to approach Diana’s onboarding.

Finally, please review the manager prep checklist below for comprehensive guidance.

Best,  
The Onboarding Team

thirty_days: Learn the architecture of the ML platform by reviewing documentation and shadowing team members.
Integrate into engineering workflows by completing a GitHub pull request on a minor bug fix or documentation update.
Meet with key team members and related teams to understand their data needs and current projects (5 meetings).
sixty_days: Build a machine learning model for a small feature by collaborating with engineering using Datadog for monitoring and feedback loops.
Lead a retrospective session about an ongoing project to gain insights into team processes.
Solidify relationships with cross-functional teams by participating in at least 3 interdisciplinary meetings.
ninety_days:
Deliver a comprehensive analysis report on the feature performance of a newly shipped model.
Present findings to the team and stakeholders.
Propose a project to improve the efficiency of data pipelines leveraging AWS and orchestrating work across data and engineering teams.
Establish a thought-leadership role within the team by authoring a blog post on a technical topic of interest.

manager_checklist: Review Diana Okafor’s resume and skills profile.
Ensure all systems access, including AWS, will be ready for July 5.
Plan first 1:1 to discuss initial projects and expectations.
Review current data science projects for potential involvement.

details.subject_line: Welcome to the ML Platform Team, Diana!
details.body:
Hi Diana,

Welcome to the ML Platform team! We're thrilled to have you join us as a Senior Data Scientist. On your first day, you'll find your MacBook Pro all set up and ready for you, and you'll have access to all the essential tools like GitHub Enterprise, Slack (especially our engineering channels), and Datadog.

You're in great hands with your onboarding buddy, Ben Silva, who will be reaching out to help you settle in. Plus, you'll have an introductory meeting with your manager on July 6th at 10:00 AM.

We're really looking forward to seeing you shine in your role here. If you have any questions or need anything before you start, feel free to reach out!

Warm regards,
The ML Platform Team
